instruction: Use AutoCAD. Open only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\user\Desktop\inch_valve.dxf. Import inch_valve.dxf. Convert the valve reference to millimeters: draw a 127 x 63.5 body rectangle on OUTLINE, ports of radius 9.525 at (25.4,31.75) and (101.6,31.75), bolt holes of radius 3.175 at (12.7,12.7), (12.7,50.8), (114.3,12.7), and (114.3,50.8), plus text ACAD-24. Use OUTLINE for the body rectangle, HOLE for ports and bolt holes, and ANNOTATION for text. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. [Software] Launch AutoCAD with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`.
